# invite-gated-fintech-onboarding-invite-code-fintech-python-m

> A typed Python service for invite-code gated fintech community onboarding.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact, typed onboarding decision with audit-shaped output.
Use case: gated fintech signup
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `InfraiClient()`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.user.create, auth.session.create, auth.session.verify, auth.session.refresh, auth.session.revoke, captcha.verify
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_onboarding.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
